name: bearchart
description: BearChart — an independent price guide for Build-A-Bear collectibles, built on real sold prices, not asking prices.

scripts.build:dev: npm run build:assets && python3 tools/build_pages.py && python3 tools/build_pwa.py
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:contrast && npm run test:assets && npm run test:sw && npm run test:sanitize && npm run test:billing && npm run test:comps && npm run test:membership && npm run test:builddata && npm run test:fit && npm run test:secsql && npm run test:pages && npm run test:import && npm run test:ebay && npm run test:poll && npm run test:seo && npm run test:submissions && npm run test:deletion && npm run test:userdata && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:audit-unit && npm run test:audit
scripts.icons: node tools/shot.js "http://localhost:5173/tools/icon_source.html?size=192" icons/icon-192.png --width=192 --height=192 --dpr=1 && node tools/shot.js "http://localhost:5173/tools/icon_source.html?size=512" icons/icon-512.png --width=512 --height=512 --dpr=1 && node tools/shot.js "http://localhost:5173/tools/icon_source.html?size=512&safe=1" icons/icon-maskable-512.png --width=512 --height=512 --dpr=1 && node tools/shot.js "http://localhost:5173/tools/icon_source.html?size=180" icons/apple-touch-icon.png --width=180 --height=180 --dpr=1
scripts.build:daily: python3 tools/build_data.py && python3 tools/export_sql.py && npm run build:dev
